create_readout_block: create a ReadoutBlock instance with global, GNN, and regularization config objects
run_readout_block_forward: run the ReadoutBlock forward pass with graph data, node features, and edge features
build_global_readout: build a global readout using compilable_scatter to aggregate node features per graph
build_node_readout: build a node readout by applying a residual feedforward network with pre-normalization
build_edge_readout: build an edge readout by applying a residual feedforward network with pre-normalization
